days.m:
okayyy before you sleep i just wanna say one thinggg 🥹❤️
just a little reminder for youuu ❤️
i hope you know how incredibly special you are to meee
you are sooooo pretty and i hope you never forget that
not just pretty in the way you look but pretty in the way you smile and laugh and talk and care and love and somehow make everything around you feel warmer
there is genuinely no one else i would rather have beside meee
and i dont know what every tomorrow will look like but i do know that i want to keep choosing you today and keep putting effort into usss
keep making memories with you
keep learning you
keep growing with you
and keep seeing where this beautiful little story of ours takes us ❤️
you mean more to me than you probably realiseee
i hope you know how incredibly special you are to meee
i love youuu exactly as you are
your sillyyy side
your angry side
your sleepy side
your little habits
all of ittt
and please dont ever feel like you have to compare yourself to anyone or wonder if youre enough for me
you areee
you really really areee
i want you to feel safe being yourself with meee
you dont have to be prettier or different or anything more than who you already are
i fell for youuu not some perfect version of you
so smile for me okayyy 🥹❤️
because my favourite version of you is the one thats happyyyy

— M
days.n: It will remind you about us

days.m:
funny how some dates are just dates until someone comes along and gives them a meaning
before you 27th May was just a date
29th May was just a date
6th June was just a date
but nowww somehow i dont think ill ever look at these dates the same way again
you entered my life so unexpectedly and in such a short amount of time you made so many normal days feel sooooo special
and its not even just the big days
its the random days too
the beach days
the cold coffee mornings
the silly little moments
the funnnyyyy conversations
the days where we literally did nothing and somehow i still remember them so deeply
i loveee how i can look at a date now and immediately think of you
you didnt just become a part of my life
you became a part of my daysss ❤️

— M
days.az:
Also — you told me what you wanted to do tonight.

I couldn’t give you the evening. So I made you the next best thing.
